components.name: Enquiry Field
components.description: Labeled input with independent focus and invalid states.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Your name<input name="name" placeholder="Your name" required /></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;color:var(--ink,#111211);font:500 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif}.ds-field input{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid #aeb9bf;border-radius:8px;background:white;color:var(--ink,#111211);caret-color:var(--red,#de2018);font:400 16px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#657179;opacity:1}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#111211);outline-offset:4px}.ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:#ad241d}

components.name: Archive Filter
components.description: Pill archive filter; selected state uses ink.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.ds-filters button{min-height:44px;padding:10px 20px;border:1px solid #adb6ba;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#111211);font:500 13px "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s,background .15s,border-color .15s}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink,#111211);border-color:var(--ink,#111211);color:white}.ds-filters button:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]){border-color:var(--ink,#111211);background:#e3e8e5}.ds-filters button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#111211);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: Signal red, pale architectural surfaces and graphite hardware express organized workmanship. Angular Russo One headlines support the existing wordmark. IBM Plex Sans keeps descriptions and controls readable. The approved continuation uses actual dimensional geometry and a camera journey through multiple services; the rack-only concept is superseded.
keyCharacteristics: Saturated red, white, pale mineral walls and dark hardware.
Angular display lettering, open composition and square primary actions.
Scroll connects electrical work, networking, a warehouse and an event.
Illustrations explain services; authentic source photos provide the work archive.

rules.name: The Separate Systems Rule
rules.body: Electrical and data installations are distinct assemblies. The red motif links services visually; it is not a wiring diagram or proof that the spaces share a circuit or geographic site.

rules.name: The Brand Asset Rule
rules.body: Display type supports the existing logo artwork; it never replaces or redraws the wordmark.

dos: Do use the same enhanced raster artwork for the cropped header wordmark and full footer logo.
Do keep generated installation imagery visibly labeled illustrative.
Do preserve source photographs and their original context, including architectural renderings in the archive.
Do keep each animated property under one timeline owner and preserve keyboard access to the currently visible hero phase.
Do retain visible focus, required-field errors and the editable enquiry review before opening WhatsApp.
donts: Don't substitute condensed Anton for the chosen angular main headline.
Don't add decorative cable-line backgrounds or diagonal promotional arrows to the selected direction.
Don't replace authentic work imagery with generated detail or infer contracts and outcomes from social collages.
Don't describe the enhanced raster logo as a certified vector master.
Don't imply that preparing or opening a WhatsApp draft sends a message.
